overview: Monitor up to four approved RTSP cameras with NVIDIA video captions, live previews, saved observations and a supervised monitoring goal.
target_users: Authorized camera operators and site reviewers.
capabilities: Monitor up to four approved RTSP cameras with NVIDIA video-window captions.
See a live preview for each camera.
Save timestamped observations and monitoring goals.
Search saved images and captions by subject and capture time.
Keep decisions and physical actions with a human supervisor.
output: Timestamped sampled video observations and reviewable reports.

product.problem: Reviewing a continuous camera feed takes sustained attention.
product.benefit: Review concise camera observations with the original video intervals.
product.how_it_works: NVIDIA DeepStream and vLLM analyze sampled video windows. The co-worker labels each saved observation and shows a separate live preview for each camera.
product.input: One to four approved RTSP cameras and an optional shared monitoring goal.
product.output: Timestamped, camera-labeled observations, reports and live previews.
product.target_users: Authorized camera operators and site reviewers.
product.customizable_for: Approved monitoring of up to four cameras.
